shell_commands:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test: acceptance tests for usage accumulation across tool rounds

Define acceptance criteria for reporting usage across every tool round,
not just the final one. Tests verify that multiple rounds' usage is
accumulated, partial/missing usage is handled correctly, backward
compatibility is maintained, and no usage is reported when appropriate.

Issues: re-cinq/HALEngine#93
EOF
)"

git commit --amend -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test: acceptance tests for usage accumulation across tool rounds

Define acceptance criteria for reporting usage across every tool round,
not just the final one. Tests verify that multiple rounds' usage is
accumulated, partial/missing usage is handled correctly, backward
compatibility is maintained, and no usage is reported when appropriate.

Issues: re-cinq/HALEngine#93

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
